<div class="review-text">
Very fun, satisfying game. A high degree of polish for an early access title, and not lacking its content; I didn't run across any recognizable bugs in the 55 hours I played. There's no real challenge to the game; it is mainly just relaxing. I found that it never really overstayed its welcome, introducing me to all of its primary elements for just as long as was appropriate. I find it quite rare that an early access game is so well-paced, so I was grateful for this.
</div>
